Found 11 items in registries @dgit:

Showing items 1-11 of 11:

- theme (registry:file) - Neutral gray scale (light and dark), shadcn's color names on it, type scale, menu animation. Import after Tailwind. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-theme (registry:lib) - System, light or dark, kept in localStorage and applied as <html data-theme>. Includes the first-paint script. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button (registry:ui) - Pill buttons, 40px tall by default. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- menu (registry:ui) - A floating panel from a trigger: 12px corners, 36px rows, grows from the trigger. No positioning library. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- account-menu (registry:ui) - Avatar button and menu: name and email, a system/light/dark switch, your links, log out. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- page (registry:ui) - PageHeader, Section, List (rounded rows), Notice, and ago() for relative times. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- copy (registry:ui) - CopyButton and CopyField (a monospace value with a copy button). [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- segmented (registry:ui) - Two or three choices in one small pill. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- app-header (registry:block) - Dashboard top bar: brand, pill navigation, and a slot for the account menu. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-layout (registry:block) - Dashboard with a sidebar: drill-in groups and route layers that slide in with a back row, a top bar with a scope switcher and breadcrumbs, a drawer on phones. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- auth-page (registry:block) - Centered 384px column, 30px title, stacked 40px pill choices, code field, 'Signing in to <app>'. [@dgit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
